title: Kavach transcript (Listener output, v1)
description: What the Listener hands to every downstream agent. Turns are in time order; each turn is one speaker's consecutive speech.

source.description: prisma-batch-diarized: one mono file, Prisma separates the speakers. prisma-batch-stereo: caller and listener on separate channels, each transcribed alone. text: a typed or dataset transcript, no audio.

language.description: Prisma language code, e.g. te-IN, en-IN

audio_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the audio file as received; null for text. The Notary seals this.

speaker_assignment.description: How the caller was identified. most_words is a guess (whoever talks more is the caller); the screen lets the family swap it, which records manual.

raw_speaker.description: Prisma's speaker_id or the channel name, kept for audit

prisma_text.description: Prisma batch text, when the per-turn pass or loanword latinising changed it

prisma.description: Provenance for the evidence packet: job and file ids, model, request settings.

warnings.description: Anything downstream agents should know, e.g. more than two speakers were found
